findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-composition-id`.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.

findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-width` or `data-height`.
findings.fixHint: Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: Missing `window.__timelines` registration.
findings.fixHint: Register each composition timeline on `window.__timelines[compositionId]`.

findings.message: Script contains `performance.now()` which produces non-deterministic output. Renders may differ between frames or runs.
findings.fixHint: Remove time-dependent code. Use GSAP timeline position instead of wall-clock time.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 667 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <div id="stage"> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: `requestAnimationFrame` runs on wall-clock time, not the GSAP timeline. It will not sync with frame capture and may cause flickering or missed frames during rendering.
findings.fixHint: Use GSAP tweens or onUpdate callbacks instead of requestAnimationFrame for animation logic.

findings.message: Font family used without @font-face declaration: plus jakarta sans. These are not in the auto-resolved font list, so the renderer cannot supply them automatically. Text will fall back to a generic font, producing incorrect typography in the video.
findings.fixHint: Add @font-face { font-family: '...'; src: url('capture/assets/fonts/...woff2'); } for each font family, pointing to the captured .woff2 files, or switch to a Google Fonts family. An OS font such as PingFang SC or Hiragino Sans renders locally from the installed copy, but a cloud render has no copy and refuses it.
